description: DailyPay is the leader in On-Demand Pay, trusted by the most forward-thinking employers committed to enhancing their employees' financial health. Our open technology platform can deliver instant access to earned wages and a robust suite of financial wellness solutions, giving our partners a decisive edge in attracting, engaging, and retaining top talent. DailyPay is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Government-Only cloud computing environment. It is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, and government contractors.
